longDescription: Explore local Codex Skills and separately recorded Skill adoptions and plugin tool-call attempts. View activity heatmaps and date-filtered rankings, inspect sources, save local notes, and preview reversible Windows user-skill archives. Recording depends on explicit caller participation: this plugin does not automatically monitor every chat, and missing records do not mean no activity. Includes first-use setup guidance. Requires Node.js 20.18+ and a compatible local Codex CLI. This is an independent open-source project; native desktop compatibility and official directory review remain pending.
defaultPrompt: Open Plugin & Skill Manager and explain my recorded activity.
Check whether Skill adoption and plugin call records have arrived.
Show my local Skill inventory and its sources.
